k: Twin batons that clip together into one staff
st: Melvin Potter builds a pair of billy clubs into the armored red suit he makes for Matt.
Matt fights the Hand with them beneath Midland Circle, until the building comes down on him.
After Foggy's death, Matt takes his billy clubs from a hidden compartment, then carries them again to save Angela.

k: Matt's vigilante gear, from black mask to red armor
The armored suit, mask and all, of Hell's Kitchen's devil
st: Matt starts out in a black outfit and mask, then beats Fisk in an armored red suit made by Melvin Potter.
Shot in the head by the Punisher, Matt has Melvin make him a new, stronger mask.
Matt puts the suit back on to fight the Hand, and is buried in it as Midland Circle collapses.
Recovering at the orphanage, Matt goes back out in his old black outfit.
In a flashback, Daredevil fights Maya Lopez to a draw while she carries out a job for Fisk.
In Los Angeles, Matt wears a red and yellow suit to fight beside She-Hulk.
Matt hides the suit on his roof after Foggy's death, then suits up again to save Angela from Muse.
Matt fights Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force in a new, darker suit, and officers pull off his mask.

k: A copy of Daredevil's suit, made on Fisk's orders
st: Fisk forces Melvin Potter to build an exact copy of Daredevil's suit.
Wearing it, Dex kills Jasper Evans at the Bulletin and Father Lantom at Clinton Church, then crashes Fisk's wedding.
Elektra fights the Yakuza and the Hand beside Daredevil with her sai.

k: A small pistol Karen buys for her own safety
st: Karen pulls the .380 she bought on Frank Castle, who approves of her choice.

k: His late father's cufflinks, worn as a warning
st: Fisk wears his father's cufflinks every day, a reminder that he is not his father.

k: A white painting Fisk meets Vanessa in front of
A looted painting Fisk still treasures
st: Fisk is drawn to it at Vanessa's gallery, where they first meet, and he buys it.
Fisk finds it with its rightful owner, Esther Falb, and lets her keep it.
Dex murders Falb and brings it to Fisk, and Vanessa notices blood on the frame.
A bloodied version hangs where Fisk holds Vanessa's lover Adam prisoner.
It is wrecked when Fisk fights Matt.

k: A video in which Ray Nadeem lays out Fisk's crimes
st: Before Fisk has him killed, Agent Nadeem records a video detailing Fisk's crimes and sends it to his wife Seema.
Foggy gets it from Seema, and Karen posts it online during Fisk's wedding, sending him back to prison.

k: Heroin stamped with a serpent insignia
A drug the Hand makes and sells in New York
st: Madame Gao sells her heroin across the city as one of Fisk's partners.
Daredevil wrecks her operation, and Gao leaves for her homeland.
A new synthetic heroin, made by the Hand's captive chemist Radovan Bernivig, reaches New York, and Ward tries it.

k: What lets the Hand cheat death
A substance drawn from the bones of a dragon
st: Nobu, who burned to death fighting Daredevil, is alive again at the Hand's Farm.
Harold Meachum, whose cancer the Hand cured, comes back from death after his son kills him.
The Hand uses the last of it to raise Elektra, and Gao reveals it comes from a dragon's bones under Midland Circle.
Midland Circle implodes on the cavern as the Hand harvests the dragon's skeleton.

k: An ancient stone device that can wake the dead
st: The children from the Farm drain their blood into it, and the Hand later places Elektra's body inside.
Elektra rises from it as the Black Sky, the Hand's weapon.

k: The mystic source of the White Tiger's power
st: Hector Ayala draws his powers as the White Tiger from it.
Angela gets her late uncle's amulet back from Kirsten McDuffie and wears it to raid Red Hook.

k: The mask of a killer who paints with blood
st: The serial killer Muse hides behind it as he drains his victims' blood for his murals.
Heather Glenn, scarred by her capture, puts on Muse's mask herself.

k: A cargo ship running weapons to Fisk's Red Hook port
st: Daredevil boards the ship, and its crew sinks it to block the port.
Fisk has the Anti-Vigilante Task Force blow up the wreck with salvagers aboard.

k: Body armor with a white skull painted on
st: Frank spray-paints a skull, from the X-ray of his own head in the paper, onto his body armor.
Frank puts on the white skull again to defend the power station against Russo's soldiers.
Frank wears it to attack Billy's robbery crew, and the skull stirs Billy's nightmares.
Frank, in his skull vest, takes on the Task Force cops who wear his symbol.
Frank locks up his Punisher gear, ready to end his life.
Frank returns to the streets in a new Punisher costume.

k: Footage of a killing by the Cerberus unit
st: Gunner Henderson films Cerberus killing Ahmad Zubair; the video is leaked to Madani, then goes missing.
Micro leaves a disc of it for Frank at his old family home.

k: The ring from Frank's marriage to Maria
st: Frank loses his wedding ring in a bar fight in Michigan.
John Pilgrim finds it at the bar and keeps it as he hunts Frank.

k: A plain white mask hiding a scarred face
st: Billy's therapist, Krista Dumont, encourages him to decorate a plain white mask.
Billy's crew wears masks as he leads them on a spree of robbery and murder.

k: Photos a teen grifter took at a funeral
st: Amy and other teen grifters are paid to photograph a funeral in Chicago, and the others are killed.
Frank and Amy develop the film: Senator David Schultz, kissing another man.
Frank and Amy use them to blackmail Anderson Schultz.

k: A paper flower from a grateful little girl
st: After Frank saves her family, Charli gives him a paper rose, and he lays it on Lisa's grave.

k: Bullets of alien metal that can pierce Luke's skin
st: Shades shows Cottonmouth the Judas bullet, made of alien metal from a stolen Hammer Industries design.
Diamondback shoots Luke with two Judas bullets, and the shrapnel nearly kills him.
Mariah gets Diamondback to arm the police with them, and a SWAT team forces Luke to surrender.

k: A Hammer Industries suit that matches Luke's strength
st: Diamondback faces Luke at Pop's barbershop in a powered suit that makes him just as strong and bulletproof.
The suit's power system fails, Luke knocks Diamondback out, and the police take him away.

k: A jar for every curse said in Pop's barbershop
st: Pop keeps a swear jar in his barbershop, and even Luke pays in when he curses.
With Pop gone, Luke makes Bobby Fish pay in, handing him a bag of Cottonmouth's money.

k: A Jamaican plant that heals and strengthens Bushmaster
st: Bushmaster buys ingredients from Tilda Johnson to boost the nightshade that heals him and makes him stronger.
Luke and Danny destroy the warehouse lab where Bushmaster's men try to grow more.
Tilda heals Bushmaster with it, warns it is killing him, then gives him one last dose to go after Mariah.

k: A robotic arm built to replace the one Misty lost
st: Colleen Wing and Danny Rand give Misty a robotic arm to replace the one Bakuto cut off.
Misty helps Colleen and Danny hunt for Davos with it.

k: The sword of a martial arts teacher
st: Colleen fights the Hand beside Danny with it, and refuses to kill her old mentor Bakuto.
Colleen beheads Bakuto beneath Midland Circle.

k: A box bearing Colleen's family crest
st: Colleen finds a box with her family's crest and traces it to Frank Choi, learning her mother may be in New York.

k: An antique bowl used to move the Iron Fist
st: Joy and Davos blackmail Mika Prada into giving them an antique bowl.
The Crane Sisters use it, with Danny's blood, to pass the Iron Fist to Davos.
Joy steals the bowl from Davos with BB's help.

n: The skin of a past Iron Fist
k: Tattooed skin from the body of an old Iron Fist
st: Davos kills the Golden Tigers at the docks to take the tattooed skin from an old Iron Fist's corpse.
It is used in the Crane Sisters' ritual that moves the Iron Fist from Danny to Davos.

k: Twin pistols that can fire the Iron Fist
st: Months later, Danny fights with two guns taken from Orson Randall, forming Iron Fists through them.

k: Pills that heal and enhance a soldier
IGH's enhancer, now in an inhaler
st: Dr. Kozlov gives Will Simpson pills that heal him and make him stronger and more violent.
Trish takes some from Simpson and uses them to help Jessica beat him.
After Simpson is killed, Trish uses his inhaler, grows addicted, and gives a dose to Malcolm.

k: Videos of experiments on a young Kilgrave
st: In a flashback, Kilgrave has Jessica dig up a box Reva Connors hid, with the drive inside.
Kilgrave shows Jessica the footage of his parents experimenting on him as a boy.
Jessica finds his parents' names on it, and later gives the drive to Luke.

k: A superhero costume Trish dreamed up for Jessica
st: In a flashback, Trish shows Jessica a costume for a hero called Jewel, and Jessica turns it down.

k: The disguise of a new masked vigilante
st: Recognized after catching a thief, Trish starts hiding her face behind a mask as she hunts criminals.

k: The leg Maya wears since the crash
st: Maya's prosthetic is wrecked in a train coupling, and Skully builds her a new one, then gives it a new look.

k: A contact lens that turns speech into sign language
st: Fisk gives Maya an augmented reality contact lens so they can talk without an interpreter.

k: A garment Maya's grandmother makes for her
st: Chula begins work on a special garment after Maya storms out.
Maya finds it finished at Chula's home and wears it to face Fisk at the powwow.

k: A monster truck at the Choctaw powwow
st: Biscuits drives a monster truck through Fisk's men at the powwow.
